interactives.label: Rules of the cut
interactives.text: One party at a time. The cut sends them to you; the benches behind stay quiet once you have cleared them. Fall and you rise at the last fire you passed. The waystones count you out.

interactives.label: Waystone
interactives.text: The waystone home. Using it counts you out of the run.

interactives.label: The grinders' ledge
interactives.text: The lens grinders tuned their hammers here. Strike the rock and it still answers.

interactives.label: The lens-grinders' strongbox
interactives.text: The road's cache. It opens once for each of you when the court is quiet.
